summary: Frontend UI verified for three flows on mobile viewport (390x844) with elite@test.com. (1) Plan-to-Workout: coach reply arrived, SAVE TO TRAIN toggled to '✓ SAVED TO TRAIN', TRAIN tab showed coach-plan-start-<id> button, tapping it opened an active editable session (finish-workout + add-exercise present) — WORKS. (2) Female visuals: profile-sex-female flipped the background image src from bg_default.png → bg_default_f.png and the avatar picker rendered female art variants; revert to profile-sex-male returned the src to bg_default.png exactly (byte-for-byte match) — WORKS. (3) Boss quest tab: '☠ BOSS' chip renders 2 boss quests (boss_frame, boss_bg), modal opens without crash, CLAIM REWARD button is disabled (aria-disabled=true, opacity 0.5) showing 'OBJECTIVES INCOMPLETE' — WORKS.

ui_bugs.issue: Parser produced 56 'exercises' when starting the saved 3-day PPL plan. It appears to be picking up narrative / description lines from the LLM response (only filters lines starting with day/week/phase/warm/cool/rest/note/superset/circuit and length<3 or >44). Real exercise-only lines for a 3-day PPL should be ~18. The session is still editable so the user can delete extras, but the UX is noisy.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use textShadow), 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Non-blocking but should be addressed for RN 0.75+ / web parity.

action_items: Consider tightening the coach-plan text→exercise parser in workout.tsx::startCoachPlan so it doesn't emit 50+ items from a normal PPL plan (e.g., require a NxM sets/reps pattern OR match against a known exercise-name list; drop items >32 chars; skip lines with prose punctuation).
(Optional cleanup) Migrate textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents style props to the non-deprecated forms to silence RN 0.75 web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: coach.tsx auth token is not persisted across a full page reload on web — direct URL navigation to /coach, /workout, /profile after login lands the user back on the login screen. Not blocking (in-app tab navigation works), but persisting the token (AsyncStorage/web localStorage in useAuth) would make deep-linking + refresh survive.
startCoachPlan (workout.tsx:114) — parser is loose; see action item #1.
